The later C037/C048 tail exits with BX=0002 and FLAGS=0202h on the B73E/BEC5 oracles. Logic 003Bh falls through C054 to default AX=A4E4h before AX is overwritten with the original logic id. Logic 0021h first gates on DS:2356: when it is not 0004h the helper returns immediately; when it is exactly 0004h it falls through to the ordinary BFD7 death/transition path.

1010:C054.name: object_deactivate_logic_dispatch_c054
1010:C054.notes: Shared object-logic selector used by BD17 and BFC7. The compare chain selects A79Ch, A6F0h, A83Eh, A82Ah, A5C0h, or A4E4h for known selector values, decrements DS:A47E for the smaller counter family, and otherwise falls through to default AX=A4E4h; observed 0000h, 0013h, and 003Bh all use that default/no-counter behavior.

1010:C3BF.name: overkill_reset_effect_slot_block_c3bf
1010:C3BF.notes: Internal compact/effect slot reset loop reached by setup code. Uses DS:8D12 pointer table, clears selected fields via SS:BP, stamps +0E from CS:C3A2, advances CS:C3A2 by 0040h, and falls through to C3E7. Verified against interpreted ASM.

1010:C3F1.name: overkill_reset_object_slot_block_c3f1
1010:C3F1.notes: Internal object slot reset loop reached by setup code. Uses DS:32CA pointer table, resets layer +0A, preserves slots whose +16 is 1, otherwise clears runtime fields, stamps +0E from CS:C3A2, advances CS:C3A2 by 0280h, and falls through to C42F. Verified against interpreted ASM.

1010:C4DB.name: overkill_reset_object_slot_and_status_setup_c4db
1010:C4DB.notes: Transition/setup parent that resets CS:C3A2, enters the C4E5 object-slot reset loop, continues through C51D tracked/status setup, and falls into 859E status-cell composition. Keeps C4E5/C51D/859E as child proof boundaries.

1010:C4E5.name: overkill_reset_object_slot_block_c4e5
1010:C4E5.notes: Internal object-slot reset loop reached by the C4DB setup/transition routine. Clears selected fields across the DS:32CA object pointer table, stamps CS:C3A2 present pointers, advances CS:C3A2 by 0280h per slot, and falls through to C51D. Verified against interpreted ASM.

1010:C51D.name: overkill_setup_tracked_status_tail_c51d
1010:C51D.notes: Setup tail after C4DB/C4E5 object reset. Clears tracked-coordinate/status globals, calls the 8517 four-entry descriptor seed, and jumps into the 859E status-cell compositor. Verified against interpreted ASM.

1010:C713.name: overkill_decoded_asset_table_search_c713
1010:C713.notes: Decoded-asset resident table search after asset materialization. Scans DS:14D0-style word list from live SI for DS:[21AA], returns immediately on match, or continues at C720 when the FFFF terminator is reached. Verified against interpreted ASM for match and terminator exits.

1010:C916.name: overkill_file_checksum_loop_c916
1010:C916.notes: Small deterministic checksum loop over bytes read from OVERKILL data file. Python replacement is regression-tested.

1010:CA18.name: wait_vga_retrace_status_read
1010:CA18.notes: Reads port 03DAh and waits for bit 3. DOSMachine.port_read now toggles that bit.

1010:CC7F.name: overkill_dirty_cell_presenter_row_cc7f
1010:CC7F.notes: Row driver inside the CC4F/CC58 dirty-cell menu/status presenter. It computes the row DI through 5A24, dispatches one of the dirty-copy leaves CCAA/CCF0/CCC4, and when DL marks a changed cell it draws the source cell and presents it through the CD7E changed-cell presenter. The hook consumes the inner CC7F..CE10 row loop until CE13; EGA mode can still continue at original 24D7/CDCC targets.

1010:CD68.name: overkill_dirty_cell_presenter_resume_cd68
1010:CD68.notes: Resume tail for the CC7F dirty-cell presenter after the nested 50C9 pacing/wait boundary. Pops the saved DI, presents the changed cell through CD7E/CDAA or CD8D, restores DS, increments the row cursor, pops the saved row counter and loops to CC7F or exits at CE13.

1010:CDAA.name: overkill_tandy_changed_dword_present_8rows_cdaa
1010:CDAA.notes: Mode-2 dirty-present loop. Copies two words from DS:SI to ES:DI for each of eight rows, advances SI by 00A0h, advances DI through Tandy +2000h interlace with +80A0h wrap correction, and continues at CE02.

1010:CE40.name: overkill_menu_transition_input_wait_ce40
1010:CE40.notes: Menu/transition input wait subroutine after dirty-cell presenter rows. Polls input through 0162, tests DS:98BE bit 10h, can latch DS:98C3=39h, then waits through the installed 50C9 retrace hook up to CX times. Uses installed 50C9 intentionally to preserve play.py pacing boundaries.

1010:CE5C.name: overkill_menu_transition_input_wait_loop_ce5c
1010:CE5C.notes: LOOP/RET tail for CE40 used when an interactive 50C9 pacing wrapper yields at the original return IP. Decrements CX without altering flags and either jumps to CE40 or returns.

1010:D007.name: overkill_main_frame_loop_d007
1010:D007.notes: Main gameplay/attract frame-loop dispatcher lifted as one verified frame iteration. Composes child proof boundaries in original CALL order and returns to D007 on same-IP loop or D040 on exit. Hook verifier uses same-IP-after-step metadata so the oracle cannot stop at the entry without executing a frame.

1010:D03E.name: main_frame_same_ip_loop_gate_d03e
1010:D03E.notes: Final CMP/JZ gate inside D007; loops back to D007 when DS:98C3 is zero. Tracked in frontier manifest because same-IP targets need min-step verifier metadata.

1010:D040.name: main_frame_exit_tail_d040
1010:D040.notes: Exit tail after D007 breaks out of the gameplay/attract frame loop. It clears DS:BDAC then calls 5AEE and 526A before returning. Left as a separate hook candidate instead of folding into D007.

1010:D04D.name: overkill_frame_ui_state_update_d04d
1010:D04D.notes: Finite per-frame UI/demo-state update block called from D007. It draws the script-selected cell, runs A212 maintenance, advances BE08/BE0A timers and either returns to D019 or hands off to original script continuation targets.

1010:D318.name: overkill_interstitial_timed_input_loop_d318
1010:D318.notes: ASM-shaped timed interstitial/input-wait frame loop. Services existing frame child hooks, increments DS:BED8, then either loops at D318 until timeout/input conditions or waits for input release before near RET. No semantic menu/screen model yet.

1010:D367.name: overkill_interstitial_status_cell_d367
1010:D367.notes: Small interstitial/status cell helper: AX=4703h, call 5A00, zero SI, switch DS to CS:95B6, call 5A6C cell blit dispatch, restore DS from CS:9596, near RET.

1010:D390.name: overkill_menu_fire_release_wait_d390
1010:D390.notes: One-poll FIRE/SPACE release wait gate before the main-menu/planet transition setup. Original D390 loop calls 0162, tests DS:98BE bit 10h, and loops while held.

1010:D434.name: overkill_selector_input_release_wait_d434
1010:D434.notes: One-poll selector input-release wait gate before falling into D445 selector loop. Waits for DS:98E4 != 1 and DS:98BE == 0.

1010:D445.name: overkill_input_selector_loop_d445
1010:D445.notes: Observed input-driven selector loop. When DS:[98E4]==1 it increments DS:[BEDC] and wraps that counter back to zero after the third tick; otherwise it polls 0162 and updates DS:[BEDA] with direction bits 1/2/4/8 as a 2x3 selector grid. Bit 10h exits only when BEDA is nonzero.

1010:ECF2.name: overkill_lz_decoder_ecf2
1010:ECF2.notes: Full OVERKILL-specific LZ asset decoder: initializes output pointer from CS:ECEE, clears ring buffer at CS:DCB8, decodes literals/backrefs, terminates on 00 00 00, restores ES and returns. Verified against interpreted ASM on synthetic literal and back-reference streams.

1010:ED97: LZ input byte reader / 1KiB refill buffer (verified hook)
1010:EDE9: LZ output byte writer / ES:DI segment wrap (verified hook)

1010:EFAE.name: overkill_object_family_dispatch_efae
1010:EFAE.notes: Second-level object family dispatcher reached from AA2B. Publishes SS:[BP+04] to DS:D1FE and SS:[BP+02] to DS:D200, then dispatches through CS:EFC4 indexed by SS:[BP+18]. Kept dispatch-only after frame verification showed inline child gameplay execution caused frame-34 drift.

1F8F:081D.name: overkill_demo_counter_tick_1f8f_081d
1F8F:081D.notes: Far-call demo/attract counter tick reached from A940 while DS:2356==5. Decrements DS:98A7, reloads a speed bucket from DS:A47E and increments DS:98A6 when it reaches zero. Live code has two proven equivalent CMP encodings here: compact 83 F8 imm8 and wide 3D imm16; both signatures are accepted by the guard.

1F8F:0922.name: overkill_gameplay_counter_tick_1f8f_0922
1F8F:0922.notes: Far-call per-frame counter tick reached from A940. Advances/toggles C812/C814/C816 and reuses the existing 1F8F:0960 gameplay counter stride loop. Not asset decode despite overlay segment residence.

1F8F:0960.name: overkill_gameplay_counter_stride_loop_1f8f_0960
1F8F:0960.notes: Near helper in overlay segment, but semantically per-frame gameplay counter state. Walks CX words spaced six bytes apart, increments each, wraps counters at 00C0h, and returns. Moved out of overlay/asset_codecs to avoid classifying by segment residence.

254A:04D7.name: overkill_overlay_container_open_entry_254a_04d7
254A:04D7.notes: Far-call overlay/container file-I/O parent. Opens either the OVERKILL container-list entry path or a direct file depending on CS:[073A] bit 0; reads 12-byte headers, computes MZ overlay directory offsets, delegates verified signature/directory/name/path subloops, seeks to the selected payload, and returns AX=BX handle plus CX:DX length. Verified from cold-start live calls and snapshot oracle.

254A:0582.name: overlay_signature_compare_loop
254A:0582.notes: Compares bytes from header at 074E against signature/table at 0756 before continuing to the overlay decode path. Hooked as part of the existing overlay asset-codec island; exits at 058D on full match and 0640 on first mismatch.

254A:05A1.name: overkill_overlay_directory_entry_scan_05a1
254A:05A1.notes: Overlay directory-entry scan loop. Reads each directory record through DOS AH=3Fh, XOR-decodes the block in place via 05BF, normalizes the requested path through 0701, compares the entry name through 05D9, and loops until a match or exhaustion. Verified against interpreted ASM with direct regression coverage.

254A:05BF: overlay/file-block XOR decode loop for default load layout (verified hook)

254A:05D9.name: overkill_overlay_entry_name_compare_05d9
254A:05D9.notes: Overlay entry-name compare helper. Skips spaces on both sides, uppercases lowercase letters from the requested name, and returns to 0607 on a match or 0637 on the first mismatch. Verified against interpreted ASM on match and mismatch paths.

254A:0701.name: overkill_overlay_path_normalizer_0701
254A:0701.notes: Overlay path-component normalizer. Conditionally trims DS:SI and ES:DI to the component after the final backslash, preserves the live BP scratch pointer, then returns with RETF to the caller frame pushed by 05A1. Verified against interpreted ASM for gate-on and gate-off paths.

32FF:0052.name: inner_unpack_relocation_bootstrap_32ff_0052
32FF:0052.notes: Runtime-allocated transient unpack/self-relocation bootstrap segment seen during cold start. Classified away from unknown for coverage triage, but not a stable game-module island; leave interpreted unless boot performance becomes a blocker.

DOS:INT21:48.name: minimal_distinct_paragraph_allocator
DOS:INT21:48.notes: Checkpoint 8 replaces the old constant 7000h placeholder with a monotonic paragraph allocator seeded by the PSP block resize. Prevents work/source/screen buffer aliasing.

DOS:INT21:4A.name: resize_memory_block_support
DOS:INT21:4A.notes: Supports OVERKILL startup shrink of the PSP block and deterministic grow/shrink of tracked most-recent allocations.
